items.h: Can't make up for dreadful defense
items.s: Prescott completed 19 of 28 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles. He added 19 yards and a TD on two carries. The Cowboys held a 28-10 lead at the half and were up 38-24 early in the fourth quarter, but abysmal efforts by the defense and special teams squandered Prescott's third straight game producing at least three touchdowns. It was the first time since Week 8 that he failed to reach 300 passing yards, but the 33-year-old QB is still on course for a career-best campaign. He'll take a 27:7 TD:INT, along with three rushing scores, into a much tougher Week 13 tilt against the Seahawks.

items.h: Dak Prescott (hand) off injury report for Week 12
items.s: Dak Prescott (hand) is off of the injury report Wednesday for the Dallas Cowboys according to Todd Archer. Prescott is good to go after a short walkthrough practice week, as the signal-caller leads a high-octane passing attack against the Eagles Thanksgiving Day.

items.h: Dak Prescott (hand) logs full practice on estimated report Monday
items.s: Dak Prescott was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated injury report. Prescott was listed with a hand injury. He should still be good to go for Thursday's game against the Eagles on Thanksgiving.

items.h: Dak Prescott a Full Participant With Hand Injury
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott (hand) picked up a left-hand injury when his left hand was bent back in the win on Sunday against the visiting Tennessee Titans, but he practiced in full on Monday and should be good for the Thanksgiving Day game on Thursday versus the division-rival Philadelphia Eagles, according to Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram. The 33-year-old Prescott and the red-hot Cowboys offense will be looking to keep things rolling against the Eagles this week on Turkey Day. Prescott has thrown for 300-plus yards in three straight games against the Indianapolis Colts, San Francisco 49ers, and Titans, and he will be looking to make it four straight against…

items.h: Dak Prescott totals five touchdowns Sunday
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 28-of-33 passes for 325 yards and four touchdowns in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans. Prescott added a fifth touchdown on the day on the ground. He tossed touchdowns to CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, Javonte Williams and Brevyn Spann-Ford through the air. He'll face the Eagles next on Thanksgiving.

items.h: Five total TDs for second straight week
items.s: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday. As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott struck again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his touchdown tally with a two-yard toss to…

items.h: Dak Prescott Takes High-End QB1 Form Into Thanksgiving
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott threw for 325 yards and four touchdowns on 33 attempts in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Tennessee Titans. He attempted 51 passes a week earlier, throwing for 343 yards and five touchdowns in a loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Dallas led 27-9 at halftime against Tennessee, and Prescott added two touchdown passes and a two-yard touchdown scramble after the break. He finished with nine rushing yards and no turnovers, good for 35.9 fantasy points in standard four-point passing touchdown leagues. Prescott said his hand bent back during a hit and that he felt fine. The Titans entered Week 11 allowing a league-worst 266.9 passing yards per game. Prescott has…

items.h: Dak Prescott Poised For Easy QB1 Production Vs Titans
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott is healthy and ready to go for Week 11, a game in which he gets a very soft matchup with one of the worst pass defenses in the NFL. The opposing Tennessee Titans allow a massive 7.8 yards per pass attempt to opposing quarterbacks this season, which is second-worst in the league. They're also the fifth-worst defense in the NFL at slowing down opposing quarterbacks for fantasy football -- they're giving up 19.3 PPR PPG to that position. Needless to say Prescott, with his elite receiving weapons in WRs CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, should have a field day in such a soft matchup. Prescott is the No. 5 overall quarterback in PPR fantasy football…

items.h: Dak Prescott Rising Up the Rankings with High Passing Volume
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott has strung together two remarkable weeks, and in the process, he has jumped to the overall QB4 spot in fantasy football scoring this season. Prescott has a whopping 678 passing yards and seven touchdowns over his last two games, bringing him to a total of 2,724 passing yards, 22 total touchdowns, and six interceptions through 10 weeks. The 33-year-old has benefitted from a very strong supporting cast headlined by wide receivers CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, and Ryan Flournoy this year, although he hasn't relied on tight end Jake Ferguson as much as in years past. This year, the Cowboys have found themselves in plenty of pass-heavy scenarios where…

items.h: Ties career high with five TDs in loss
items.s: Prescott completed 30 of 51 passes for 343 yards with five touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. He also ran for a two-point conversion. Playing catch-up from the second quarter on did wonders for Prescott's fantasy production, as the veteran quarterback sent 38 total targets in the direction of the talented trio of George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy alone. Prescott connected with Pickens for three of his scoring strikes, which went for 35, 39 and five yards. Flournoy (11 yards) and Lamb (one yard) accounted for the final two in the fourth quarter, and Prescott added a two-point conversion run…

items.h: Dak Prescott tosses five touchdowns in Week 10 loss to 49ers
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 30-of-51 pass attempts for 343 yards, five touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 Week 10 loss to the 49ers. Prescott continues an impactful stretch of late, recording two or more touchdowns in each of his last four games. The dynamic signal-caller will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Tennessee Titans secondary in Week 11.

items.h: Dak Prescott Posts Massive Numbers in Week 10 Loss
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott did everything he could in his team's 46-40 Week 10 loss to the San Francisco 49ers, completing 30 of 51 pass attempts for 343 yards, five touchdowns, and one interception. Across 10 games in 2026, Prescott has thrown for 2,724 yards, 21 touchdowns, and six interceptions. The 33-year-old has topped 330 passing yards in back-to-back games, and he's thrown multiple touchdown passes in three of the last four weeks. With the Cowboys' defense looking as vulnerable as ever in Week 10, Prescott appears likely to continue playing in games with pass-heavy game scripts. He's averaged 38.7 pass attempts per game in 2026 and 38.0 pass attempts per game since the…

items.h: Dak Prescott Remains a QB1 Against San Francisco
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott gets George Pickens (hamstring) back for Sunday's game against San Francisco. Pickens was limited Thursday, practiced fully Friday and carries no game designation. Prescott threw for 335 yards and two touchdowns without him at Indianapolis. His two longest completions went to different receivers, with CeeDee Lamb gaining 48 yards and Ryan Flournoy's 46-yard catch setting up the winning score. San Francisco picked off Kirk Cousins three times in Week 9 without recording a sack. The Raiders got 148 yards on 10 catches from their tight ends, while their wide receivers combined for 73 yards. Dallas will face that defense without tight end Jake Ferguson…

items.h: Jerry Jones Says Teams Haven't Called About Trading for Dak Prescott
items.s: Dallas owner Jerry Jones said that trade calls for quarterback Dak Prescott have not come in over the years. Jones added that for most of Prescott's Cowboys tenure, the team hasn't been in a position where trading him away made any sense. He's played in nine games this season and 148 contests over his 11-year career with the Cowboys. This year, Prescott has a 64.9% completion mark, plus 2,381 passing yards and 16 touchdowns. He's thrown five interceptions, while rushing for 102 yards and a score across 25 attempts. Dallas is just 4-5 this season, but is comfortably in second place in the NFC East, only trailing the Giants, who are 5-2-1, so a playoff push is within reason.

items.h: Another 300-yard tally in win
items.s: Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for one yard in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble. Prescott had a couple of bumps in the road against an inconsistent Colts defense, but the veteran signal-caller, who was also working without George Pickens (hamstring), still found his way to his third 300-yard effort of the season. Prescott unsurprisingly bestowed plenty of attention on CeeDee Lamb, who ultimately was responsible for 10 of his completions, 195 of his yards and one of his two TDs. Prescott also connected with Jake Ferguson for a 10-yard scoring strike early in the second…

items.h: Dak Prescott throws two TDs in Week 9 win
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9. Prescott turned in a solid game, tying a season-high with his 335 passing yards. One of Prescott's touchdown passes went to CeeDee Lamb while the other went to Jake Ferguson. Prescott has now thrown 16 touchdowns and five interceptions through nine games. He will be a mid-range QB1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

items.h: Dak Prescott Faces Touchdown-Friendly Colts Defense
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott enters Sunday's road game against the Indianapolis Colts as a strong QB1, with RotoBaller's November 7 rankings placing him at QB5. The Colts rank 12th in net passing yards allowed (211.8 per game), but have surrendered 14 passing touchdowns while intercepting only two passes. That vulnerability was clear in Week 8, when Trevor Lawrence needed just 14 attempts to throw for 210 yards and three touchdowns against Indianapolis. Prescott's recent outings have been less consistent: he threw three touchdowns against Philadelphia in Week 7, then managed 195 passing yards against Arizona, scoring his first rushing touchdown of the season. Still, he has 2,046…

items.h: Dak Prescott's High-Volume Offense Sets Him Up Well Going Forward
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott is putting together another QB1 season for fantasy managers, throwing 14 touchdowns to five interceptions, 2,046 yards, and rushing for 101 yards and a touchdown. He is currently QB6 this season and has star weapons like George Pickens and CeeDee Lamb to throw to. Under the hood, Prescott is potentially in for a positive regression, ranked 12th in fantasy points per game but 7th in expected fantasy points per game. Prescott is mostly getting there on volume, ranking fifth in dropbacks per game, and with the Cowboys' defense struggling, allowing the fourth-most points on the season amongst all defenses, the Cowboys offense will always need to put its…

Records two total TDs on Sunday
items.s: Prescott was 19-for-29 passing for 195 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions while rushing seven times for 20 yards and one more TD during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals. Arizona's defense had been plenty exploitable this season, allowing 243.7 yards per game and 17 TDs through the air to opposing QBs heading into Week 8 action. Even with his main skill-position talents available Sunday, though, Prescott didn't crack 200 passing yards for the first time since Week 1. He salvaged his day with his first TD on the ground of the campaign, which supplemented a nine-yard TD connection with WR Ryan Flournoy. Prescott and the Cowboys offense will look to get back on track next…

items.h: Dak Prescott records two touchdowns in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-29 pass attempts for 195 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 20 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8. Prescott was unable to find consistent success Sunday, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a leaky Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

Dak Prescott A Must-Start QB1 Vs Cardinals In Week 8
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott should not be left out of starting lineups in any fantasy football leagues in Week 8. He gets a home matchup with the Arizona Cardinals, who are simply a bad team with a bad defense that's been torn to shreds by opposing quarterbacks this season. If you simply started the QB that faced Arizona each week, you'd have gotten an average of 22.3 fantasy points per game, which would rank as the No. 2 overall quarterback in fantasy football if it were done by one player. items.h: Dak Prescott tosses three touchdowns in win Monday
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 15-of-27 passing attempts for 212 yards and three touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. Prescott had a pretty nice showing on Monday night. He totaled over 200 yards on the night and was able to score three touchdowns while leading the Cowboys to a comfortable win over Philadelphia. He will continue to be a good depth piece or streaming option in most leagues moving forward.

items.h: Trio of TDs in Week 7 win
items.s: Prescott completed 15 of 27 passes for 212 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for eight yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night. He also had a two-point conversion run. The Cowboys were able to keep Prescott upright throughout the night, and the veteran signal-caller leveraged the solid protection into his first multi-touchdown-pass tally since Week 2. Prescott connected with CeeDee Lamb (nine, 16 yards) and George Pickens (21 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and although his 55.6 percent completion rate was a season low, Prescott was able to steer clear of interceptions after throwing two apiece in Weeks 5 and 6.…

items.h: Dak Prescott A Borderline Top-10 QB In Fantasy Football For Week 7
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott still ranks as the QB12 in fantasy football leagues despite a string of disappointing losses. He's had a safe floor this season, as he's scored double-digit PPR fantasy points in all six of his games so far. The Cowboys will face the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 7. They're a favorable matchup for opposing QBs on paper, as they allow the ninth-most fantasy points to the position per game this season. That said, matchups with the NFC East are often strange in nature, and can be hard to predict. The Eagles offense has struggled all season, and now is missing its starting quarterback, Jalen Hurts (deep vein thrombosis). This should give Dallas an…

items.h: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 6 loss
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 34 of his 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding two rushes for seven yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6. Prescott and the Cowboys were shut out by the Packers in the first half before showing some life after halftime. The veteran's lone TD pass went to Ryan Flournoy with 44 seconds left in the contest. Prescott survived an injury scare in the first half as he took a huge hit after a pass attempt and appeared to be favoring his ribs. He ultimately didn't miss any time in the game, but it is something worth monitoring this week. Prescott has now thrown for 1,639 yards, 10 touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games…

items.h: Late TD not enough in Week 6 loss
items.s: Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers. He also rushed twice for seven yards. Prescott threw for just 86 yards with two interceptions in the first half, and the Cowboys took a 17-0 deficit into the locker room. He was only moderately more effective in the second half as Dallas looked out of sorts offensively for a second consecutive game in primetime. Prescott's lone touchdown pass was a six-yarder to Ryan Flournoy in the final minute of the fourth quarter. Dallas dropped to 2-4 with Sunday night's loss, and Dak has an ugly 4:4 TD:INT over his last four starts after posting a 6:1 mark through Week 2.…

items.h: Dak Prescott Still A Fantasy Football QB1 in Week 6 at Packers
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott will face the Green Bay Packers on the road in Week 6 after a disappointing performance in Week 5. He failed to lift the Cowboys to a win against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers sans their starting quarterback, Baker Mayfield (thumb). This week, he'll face one of the tougher defenses against quarterbacks in the NFL -- Green Bay has allowed the fifth-fewest fantasy points per game to opposing QBs this season. It looks like wide receiver CeeDee Lamb will return for Week 6 without restrictions, but he may still be slowed down by the thigh injury that affected him in Week 5. Prescott wasn't very effective with Lamb out of the lineup, and threw just one…

items.h: Dak Prescott Remains a High-Floor QB1 With High-End Volume
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott threw two interceptions in the upset loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last Thursday night, but he still managed to throw for over 300 yards for the second straight week on 42 passing attempts while adding one touchdown. Dallas' offense struggled as a whole, though, and it did not help matters that star receiver CeeDee Lamb suffered a quadriceps injury in the second half and was unavailable to return late in the fourth quarter. He has only thrown one touchdown in each of the last three games after starting the 2026 campaign with six touchdown passes and just one pick in the first two contests. The four-time Pro Bowler has thrown for 1,381 yards, nine…

items.h: Dak Prescott throws for 316 yards in loss
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards and a touchdown with two picks in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs. It was not Dak's best showing, struggling against a secondary that had been picked on up to this point in the season. He will look to right the ship against the Packers on Sunday Night Football a little over a week from now.

items.h: Piles up yards late in Week 5 loss
items.s: Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers on Thursday night. Prescott's final yardage number was sure to please fantasy managers, but there was a pretty sizable gulf between that figure and the veteran signal-caller's actual play-to-play performance most of the night. Prescott and the air attack struggled through more than a half against an aggressive Buccaneers defense, including on a third-quarter interception that led to a Tampa Bay touchdown. However, he came alive on a mid-fourth-quarter drive where the Cowboys sped up the pace, capping that 10-play, 99-yard possession off with an 18-yard…

items.h: Dak Prescott's Fantasy Value On Shakier Ground After Week 5 Loss
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott was poised to heavily exploit the porous secondary of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in their Week 5 contest on Thursday Night Football. Instead, he threw two interceptions and managed just one passing touchdown, though his 316 passing yards were adequate. One of the picks wasn't his fault, though -- it was tight end Jake Ferguson who failed to corral a pass that hit him in the hands, and the ricochet flew high in the air and landed in the hands of a Bucs defender. Prescott's fantasy value is likely to take a hit due to the injury to his elite WR1, CeeDee Lamb (quad), but Prescott still scored over 14.6 PPR fantasy points in the loss. It was his lowest…

items.h: Prescott completed 32 of 45 passes for 335 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans. He added seven yards on two carries.
items.s: A surreal 21 of Prescott's 45 attempts went to CeeDee Lamb, and the duo connected on a 12-yard TD with just 40 seconds left in the game for the game-winning score after Javonte Williams had scored Dallas' first three touchdowns in the second half as part of a comeback from a 16-6 halftime deficit. The 335 passing yards (189 of them to Lamb) were a season high for Prescott, and he'll take an 8:1 TD:INT through four games into a Week 5 battle at home against the Buccaneers.
